points: The 2024 NHL entry draft was the National Hockey League's 62nd draft.
The draft took place on June 28–29, 2024.
The draft was held at Sphere.
Sphere is in Paradise, Nevada.
The Arizona Coyotes franchise was deactivated.
The Utah Hockey Club was a new franchise.
All draft rights held by the Arizona Coyotes transferred to the Utah Hockey Club.
The agreement governing the transfer of Arizona's draft rights was reached in April 2024.
The San Jose Sharks held the first overall pick.
This was the first time San Jose had held the first overall pick in franchise history.
San Jose selected Macklin Celebrini first overall.
The Chicago Blackhawks selected Artyom Levshunov second overall.
The Anaheim Ducks selected Beckett Sennecke third overall.
Ice hockey players born from January 1, 2004, through September 15, 2006, were eligible for the 2024 draft.
Undrafted players from outside North America who were born in 2003 were also eligible.
Players drafted in 2022 could re-enter in 2024 if they had not signed with an NHL team and were born after June 30, 2004.
Since the 2012–13 NHL season, every team missing the Stanley Cup playoffs has had a weighted chance to win the first overall pick.
The NHL changed the lottery weighting system beginning with the 2014–15 season.
The revised weighting lowered the lottery odds for the league's four lowest-finishing teams.
The revised weighting raised the lottery odds for the other non-playoff teams.
The NHL reduced the number of lottery drawings before the 2021–22 season.
The reduction changed the number of drawings from three to two.
Since the 2022 lottery, a team winning a drawing has been allowed to move up no more than ten places in the draft order.
Since the 2022 lottery, a team has been allowed to move up by winning a drawing no more than twice in a five-year period.
The two 2024 lottery drawings were held on May 7, 2024.
San Jose won the 2024 lottery drawing for the first overall pick.
Chicago won the 2024 lottery drawing for the second overall pick.
The 2024 lottery did not change the draft order.
The 2024 lottery was the first since 2010 to leave the draft order unchanged.
Chicago won the first overall pick in the 2023 lottery.
Chicago's 2024 lottery win did not improve its position in the draft order.
Chicago remained eligible to win the lottery again in 2025 because its 2024 win did not move it up.
The top-prospect ranking came from NHL Central Scouting.
The cited NHL Central Scouting ranking was dated April 16, 2024.
